cause: ProjectService.update mutated its persisted row to the response-friendly status name before building project events.
change: Publish from the persisted UUID row; return a separate response clone retaining named-status compatibility.

red.mismatch: Named-status event changes.status.new was in_progress rather than persisted UUID

cases: Named status input: response name preserved; persisted UUID emitted in updated and status-changed events
UUID input: UUID response and event identity preserved
Repeated same status by name or UUID: no false status-changed event
validation.database: Unique disposable project_status_test_<uuid>; migrated/seeded through existing helper and dropped after run

limitations: Real native PostgreSQL service and payload builders; publisher is mocked at delivery boundary, no live Redis or mail-delivery proof.
Observed CI replay predates upgrade browser actions; delayed delivery across database repointing is a separate harness lifecycle concern.
No Hocuspocus JWT-secret repair or complete subscriber replay repair included.
